videos.title: InfoVeg TV Episode 16 | Integrated Pest Management
videos.author: AUSVEG
videos.moduleTitle: Living systems and integrated pest management
videos.purpose: Compare the monitoring and integrated response ideas in the clip with the authorised IPM lesson.
videos.watchFor: Watch for how the problem is identified, which controls are combined and how results are monitored.

videos.title: Q&A - Opportunities to value add up the food chain
videos.author: ABARES Outlook 2019
videos.purpose: Introduce value adding as a supply-chain decision and identify where evidence is needed.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the original product, what changes, who values the result and what evidence supports the opportunity.

videos.title: Over the Fence: Soil health driving crop improvement at Jandowae
videos.author: Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC)
videos.moduleTitle: Soil health and technology in plant systems
videos.purpose: Connect soil observations and management choices with crop performance without treating one case as universal.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the soil evidence collected, the management response and the limits of applying one farm's result elsewhere.

videos.title: Precision Ag in Practice: James Venning | Improving input use and farm management
videos.author: Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC)
videos.moduleTitle: Soil health and technology in plant systems
videos.purpose: Show how precision-agriculture data can support targeted input and management decisions.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the problem, the data used, the decision it supports and any cost, skill or maintenance limitation.

videos.title: Drone weed mapping case study: Precision weed management
videos.author: Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC)
videos.moduleTitle: Crop monitoring and weed, pest and disease management
videos.purpose: Provide a mapping case for observing weeds and planning an evidence-based response.
videos.watchFor: Watch for what the drone detects, how the map changes the decision and what still requires ground checking.

videos.title: Using soil moisture probes to make better farming decisions
videos.author: Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC)
videos.moduleTitle: Crop monitoring and weed, pest and disease management
videos.purpose: Demonstrate how a sensor reading becomes one input to a farming decision rather than an automatic answer.
videos.watchFor: Watch for where readings come from, how they are interpreted and what other evidence affects the decision.

videos.title: Summer cover crops | central and southern NSW
videos.author: Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC)
videos.purpose: Provide a NSW case for evaluating cover-crop purpose, evidence and limitations.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the intended benefit, the conditions of the case and the trade-offs that must be evaluated.

videos.title: Making More from Sheep | Optimal Prime Lamb Flock Structure
videos.author: meatandlivestock
videos.moduleTitle: Prime lamb breeding and reproductive technologies
videos.purpose: Show how flock structure is considered against a production objective and records.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the stated objective, the records used and the assumptions that would need checking for another flock.

videos.title: Ruminant Nutrition Clip 3: Animal intake and pasture quality.
videos.author: LeadingSheepProject
videos.purpose: Connect animal intake and pasture quality with the authorised nutrition and feed-availability lesson.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the pasture evidence that influences intake and why animal stage and conditions still matter.

videos.title: MLA Feedback Episodes | Shelter me
videos.author: meatandlivestock
videos.moduleTitle: Genetic engineering, ethics, welfare and husbandry
videos.purpose: Prompt observation of shelter and welfare evidence and the management trade-offs involved.
videos.watchFor: Watch for observable animal or paddock evidence, the purpose of shelter and what cannot be concluded from one scene.

videos.title: MLA challenge - John Ramsay quarter four: Finishing lambs
videos.author: meatandlivestock
videos.purpose: Provide a case for identifying management decisions, records and business evidence without copying farm-specific settings.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the decision being made, the evidence used and which values or procedures belong only to this farm context.

videos.title: Discover how milk is made
videos.author: Discover Aussie Dairy
videos.moduleTitle: Milk processing, marketing and the Australian dairy industry
videos.purpose: Give an Australian farm-to-product overview for sequencing the milk pathway.
videos.watchFor: Watch for distinct collection, processing, packaging and distribution stages and the purpose of each.

videos.title: Australian Dairy Story
videos.author: dairyaustralia
videos.moduleTitle: Dairy farming, breeds and cow anatomy
videos.purpose: Orient students to the Australian dairy system and the people and stages examined in the authorised sequence.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the connected farm, processing and industry roles rather than memorising changeable statistics.

videos.title: Pre-milking teat preparation in Australian dairies
videos.author: Dairy Australia
videos.moduleTitle: Production cycles, emerging technologies and dairy careers
videos.purpose: Observe an Australian pre-milking preparation context without replacing local animal-care or WHS procedures.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the purpose and sequence of the preparation shown; local practice remains teacher-controlled.

videos.title: Milking Edge: training and extension program for automatic milking in Australia
videos.author: NSW Agriculture
videos.moduleTitle: Production cycles, emerging technologies and dairy careers
videos.purpose: Introduce automatic milking as an Australian technology case for evaluation.
videos.watchFor: Watch for the problem the technology addresses, the information it produces and the cost, training or maintenance implications.

videos.title: Navigate Your Dairy features the basics of hormones in cows
videos.author: CentralStar Cooperative
videos.moduleTitle: Female reproduction, hormones and the oestrous cycle
videos.purpose: Support hormone vocabulary and system relationships before returning to the authorised Australian lesson.
videos.watchFor: Watch for which hormone is linked to each reproductive event and separate explanation from treatment advice.

videos.title: How Cows Create Milk - 3D animated tour
videos.author: Discover Aussie Dairy
videos.moduleTitle: Male reproduction and the mammary system
videos.purpose: Provide a spatial overview of milk formation and movement alongside the authorised mammary-system theory.
videos.watchFor: Watch for where milk is produced, how it moves through the mammary system and which structures store or release it.
